ops.text: Customer (the Company) may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 90 days' written notice to HDI. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term and only upon 90 days' written notice to Customer.

ops.oldText: an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: an amount equal to the aggregate fees for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, which amount shall not exceed three (3) months' fees.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.1 only blocks automatic renewal, so we have added an express Customer (Company) right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice and limited HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice. We have also replaced the Net Sales exit formula with our fallback cap of three months' fees.
proposal.summary: Add a Customer convenience right on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's convenience right to term end, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees

mappings.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees.
Vendor termination for convenience only at the end of a term.
90 days' notice for Vendor termination for convenience.
